description: Where the actual trade happens, and it is a watchmaker's room rather than an ironmonger's. Locks in pieces on a green cloth, each one on its own square of paper with its screws in a dish. A board of picks and tension wrenches in order of thickness, and a second board of them in order of how often they are used, which is a different order and is the one he actually reaches from. Notes pinned everywhere in tiny capitals, most of them a lock's name and a number.
name: Skeleton Crew — The Bench
